The available producer is initial generation 1, not the last ordinary joint frame; generation-5 guess quality is unmeasured.
recommendation.dense_4M: Same explicit iterative geometry and anchors. Strict 17 RHSs each take six iterations but only 0.0563 seconds (0.139% of fit); conversion/residual setup can erase the small opportunity.
recommendation.dense_1M: Explicit-direct Strict solve is ineligible. Keep the cold direct path.
recommendation.sparse_1M: All 445 ordered component-anchor tuples match in both Strict attempts, but both canonical builders decline. This is an essential fallback/rollback control, not an anchor-mismatch exclusion. Do not introduce a workload-specific fence or assume failed cold assembly becomes a successful producer.
recommendation.scientific_integrity: All four trace-only probe scientific fingerprints, including external column hashes, exactly match qualified E1 Linux one-worker fingerprints.
recommendation.performance_limit: One traced shared-SCC fit per case, with instrumentation inside clocks. No net saving, Mac qualification, worker scaling or repeatability claim.

prototype_contract.owner: Optional session-owned per-RHS right bank plus old RHS scales and exact stable coordinate identities; no joint-fit coefficient substitution.
prototype_contract.eligibility: Same immutable sample/topology, eliminated effect, exact generated ordering and all component anchors; current consumer iterative. Rebuild all weight-dependent geometry. No benchmark names, size fences or route changes to create eligibility.
prototype_contract.conversion: new_reduced_guess = old_right * nonzero(old_RHS_scale) / nonzero(new_RHS_scale) * new_root; then divide by the original new RHS maximum for the current CG normalization. Invalid/nonfinite conversion declines before iteration.
prototype_contract.stopping: Recompute b_new - A_new*x_guess; preserve original new RHS norm, config.tolerance*0.01 and configured/component iteration cap. Zero original RHS takes the existing zero solution. Guesses confer no certificate.
prototype_contract.memory: Charge actual capacities across all ordinary phases and simultaneous old/new canonical banks. Move, never clone. An optional guess must not reduce the budget enough to select a different Fast/Low or explicit/implicit route; release and cold-fallback if full overlap is not admitted.
prototype_contract.transaction: Only a completed producer may become retained. Failed staging, allocation, Break or rollback clears speculative guesses without allocating; rank/basis authority and accepted frame rollback remain independent.
prototype_contract.unresolved_retry_contract: Freeze behavior and iteration accounting if warm CG fails numerically. An automatic full-budget cold retry could double configured work; existing builder NonConvergence invokes projection fallback. No hidden reset or unscoped fallback/outer-count change.
prototype_contract.sparse_guard: A structurally compatible guess could reach the sparse attempts that decline when cold. Any changed fallback, certificate, discrete decision or unscoped outer count blocks the variant; no case-specific exclusion repairs it.
prototype_contract.witnesses: Current strict/final-Hessian and rollback fixtures, original-RHS norm and zero/tiny-RHS cases, unequal weight/RHS scales, changed anchors/disconnected components, independent explicit-dummy PPML coefficient/covariance/score witnesses, worker repeats, allocation and Break. Saved-FE outputs need named scope/witness or must decline.
prototype_contract.remaining_budget: Four preflight fits and 127.149 seconds are charged to the 48-fit/3600-second discovery maximum; a full 24-fit panel leaves twenty corrected calls.
